description: Station network topology before mobile PWA gateway addition

8000.purpose: Desktop browser UI and frontend reverse proxy to agent-server
lan_limitations: HTTP origin over remote LAN IP is treated as Insecure Context by Chromium/Android
Service Worker registration is blocked on insecure remote origins
PWA installation (beforeinstallprompt) is disabled on insecure origins
Microphone access (getUserMedia) is blocked on insecure origins, breaking voice STT
No mobile-optimized responsive styles for Android viewports (<768px)

8080.purpose: Dynamic model router for Qwen 3.8 and Ornith 1.5 backends
8080.security_requirement: Must strictly remain loopback-only to prevent unauthorized LLM access

18000.purpose: Core agent execution engine, workspace management, event stream

18002.purpose: Local neural STT (GigaAM v3) and TTS (Supertonic 3) endpoints
18002.security_requirement: Loopback-only; mobile voice must route via secure LAN gateway proxy

conclusion: Plain HTTP on port 8000 does not satisfy Chrome PWA installability or mobile voice requirements. Dedicated secure LAN Gateway on port 8443 is required.
